what: Verification of the 5.10 baseline before any change (Phase 1 of the plan, first instruction)

developmentMachine.host: Ubuntu 24.04 container, 2 logical processors, 7 GiB, gcc 13.3.0, Node v22.23.5, Python 3.13.18; no MinGW, Wine or PowerShell and no permission to install packages
developmentMachine.note: the three Linux programs of validation/5.10/linux-bin and the interface, byte for byte

hostedRunner.host: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04, g++-mingw-w64-x86-64-posix 13 and libz-mingw-w64-dev from the distribution (the toolchain of BUILD-5.10.md)
hostedRunner.note: the three Windows executables of the delivered archive, byte for byte; the Linux programs and the interface as well

regressionSuite.where: development machine, against the rebuilt Linux programs, in the extracted release tree

failedHere.test: 4.1 response gains: seats run in parallel with results bit-identical for 1, 2 and 4 threads
failedHere.reason: asserts that three seats ran side by side (2 !== 3): the machine has 2 logical processors

failedHere.test: 5.10 processing modes: rbes beside the CUDA scoring route (simulated driver)
failedHere.reason: a route decision that depends on measured timings chose 'CPU after measuring CUDA' instead of 'Hybrid' while the convergence experiment and a build were running on the same two processors

regressionSuite.note: both are properties of this machine under load, on the UNMODIFIED 5.10 program; on the hosted 4-processor runner the 5.11 suite passes both (validation/5.11/tests)

selfTests.where: development machine, the rebuilt (byte-identical) 5.10 Linux mwcli, in the extracted release tree
selfTests.order: the regression suite of the baseline (which runs these self-tests too) was started before any source file was changed and finished while development was in progress; this direct run of the five self-tests was made afterwards, with the same unmodified binary in the same unmodified tree

notVerifiedHere: nothing was executed on Windows or a GPU for the baseline; the user's own result for 5.10 (220 passed, 0 failed, CUDA included) is the evidence for that
